note: Community campground in the hamlet of Cereal in the Special Areas, run by the Cereal & District Board of Trade: a gravel loop of lots on the west side of the hamlet, north of Hwy 9, with a picnic area and a covered camp kitchen. Day use is free. --Claude
summary: Read the Special Areas Board tourism page (2022 post) and Travel Alberta's listing: 14 lots with water and power, C$25 a night, open May to October, outhouses, sewer dump, drinking water. Sites count 14 written; facilities and season made manual. No phone or website of the campground's own; Google 4.4 (23), no phone. Pin ~115 m east of the loop (OK).
flags: RATE DATE: the only official source for C$25 is the Special Areas Board's tourism post, dated 25 April 2022 (Travel Alberta's listing repeats it, undated). Below the 2024+ bar for a dated rate; the stored fees (no method, sourced to the same page 2026-10-15) were left alone for the reviewer.

PRESENCE: no website of the Board of Trade's own and no phone anywhere (Travel Special Areas lists none; Travel Alberta's 'Visit Website' goes to albertacampsites.com, an aggregator; Google Maps 'Cereal Campground' 4.4 stars, 23 reviews, 'Add place's phone number'). It is a local (community-board) entry rather than private, so the private presence test may not apply; reported.
HOOKUPS: 'serviced lots with water and power' - power amperage not stated, so electric left unknown; water true stands.
BOOKING: no source says first-come or self-pay; the derived FCFS stays as is (pages silent).

NOTE: old note's 'run by the Cereal & District Board of Trade' is supported (the pages name the 'Cereal Board of Trade Campground'); 'Special Areas No. 2' dropped from the note (no page read names the Special Area number). 'easy pull-through access' is unsourced and dropped.

FIRE: a grassfire on October 17, 2026 started east of Cereal and ran northeast then southeast toward Lanfine (4,467 acres; one residence and the Lanfine hall lost). The Special Areas news item does not mention the campground; nothing indicates damage.

PIN (51.41750,-110.80300): in the open field east of the campground loop; the RV loop with parked units is ~115 m west, matching Google's place point 51.417486,-110.8046. Optional move to 51.41749,-110.80460.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed (only a small dugout pond north of the field).
